title: Vibeloy version policy manifest
description: Served at https://<slug>.vibeloy.dev/version.json. Clients ignore unknown keys, and show nothing when the manifest cannot be used.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version. Clients ignore the manifest unless this is exactly 1.

app.description: Informational. Clients do not read this block.

ios.description: Policy for iOS. Null or missing: the iOS client shows nothing.

android.description: Policy for Android. Null or missing: the Android client shows nothing.

message.description: Overrides the dialog body text. Null or missing: clients use their default text.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last policy change. Informational.

minVersion.description: Versions below this get the force dialog.

latestVersion.description: Versions below this (and not below minVersion) get the soft dialog.

storeUrl.description: Opened by the Update button. Null: Android falls back to the Play Store by package name, iOS hides the button.
